Real-world acceptance checks

Checklist for each phase's done-when criterion in SPEC §11. Also waiting: the four open questions.

Open questions

  • Should the ledger also show net 'who owes whom' balances (display only), or only each person's share per expense and per month?
  • Does the away flatmate pay maintenance or other fixed bills, or only rent and WiFi?
  • Maid's pay: reduced for leave days like the cook's, or fixed?
  • How should a member who leaves the flat for good settle up? Does the ledger need a 'settled' marker?

Known issues

  • No screenshots for Phases 1–5 or the sign-in change (built before this log existed).
  • No section's 'done when' criterion in SPEC §11 has been checked with real use yet (a week of chores, a month of money, 20 real bills).
  • §12 cases are covered by unit tests on the engine functions; there are no end-to-end UI tests.
  • The menu plan (Order in / We'll cook) is still one choice per day, even when the cook misses only one meal.

Decisions

  • 2026-11-05 — Design direction: the SPEC §6.1 mockup tokens (Manrope, #F5F4EF background, #0F6E64 accent, 16px cards, Lucide-style icons). design-taste-frontend is not installed, so this direction is kept for every later section.
  • 2026-11-05 — Sign-in uses Tenant's own username and password accounts, not Supabase Auth.
  • 2026-11-05 — Bill scanning runs on free tiers only: Gemini Flash first, Groq Llama 4 Scout as fallback.
  • 2026-11-05 — Project log was set up by hand: the section-status-artifact and section-sync-check skills are not installed.
  • 2026-11-05 — Part-day away: slots (morning/afternoon/night) for a single day; they only change meals. Chores and money treat the person as home. Breakfast added to the menu.

Changelog

2026-11-05 — Pushed to GitHub

  • Branch renamed master → main and pushed to https://github.com/Danielraj5605/Tenant. Secret scan of the tree and history found only placeholders.

2026-11-05 — Part-day away (Morning / Afternoon / Night) and breakfast

  • Away form: untick "Away the whole day" to pick Morning (breakfast), Afternoon (lunch) and/or Night (dinner). Single day only; Until locks to From.
  • Part-day absences only change meals: per-meal headcount and per-meal "No cook". Chores, rotation and present-only splits treat the person as home. Cook part days stay paid.
  • Breakfast added to the menu (plan, Menu page, Today).
  • Calendar: "Out part of the day: name (night)"; no "Back" date for part days. Alerts and push say "No cook for dinner".
  • Migration 20261110000001_away_slots_breakfast.sql pushed (adds columns only); daily and notify functions redeployed.
  • 144/144 tests; browser check of the full flow (14 checks) passed; test data removed.

2026-11-05 — First run fixes

  • Pushed the two pending migrations (bills_storage, own_auth) to Supabase; sign-up failed without app_users.
  • .env.local had the publishable key in SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY; the user replaced it with the secret key.
  • Fixed the Date.now() prerender error on signed-in pages: currentUserId() now calls connection() first (lib/auth/server.ts).

2026-11-05 — Project log and test-case audit

  • Set up .project-log/: status.json, REQUESTS.md, this changelog, render.mjs and the status page.
  • Filled in Phases 1–5 and the sign-in change from git history.
  • Ran npm run check: typecheck and lint clean, 131/131 tests pass (12 files).
  • Mapped all 13 SPEC §12 cases to passing tests (see status page).
  • Known gap: no screenshots for earlier phases.
